description: A publishing organization (publisher house, imprint, or self-publishing author-as-publisher), published by the catalog as a stable reference target for the inline `community.lexicon.media.book.defs#publisher` entry on edition records. Records are keyed by TID and addressed under the catalog publisher's DID.

main.description: A publisher entity. The name and identifiers mirror `community.lexicon.media.book.defs#publisher`; operational dates and descriptive metadata live here.

name.description: Publisher name, as displayed. Identifiers, not this name, are the matching mechanism.

image.description: Optional logo or image. The blob must belong to the repository containing this record, so a catalog that does not own the bytes must use imageUrl instead. May coexist with imageUrl.

imageUrl.description: Optional logo or image URL. Unlike image, a URL does not preserve the bytes in the repository.

identifiers.description: Identifiers denoting this publisher in global or provider namespaces, compared exactly by issuer and value.

started.description: Date the publisher began operating, as a full ISO 8601 calendar date, exactly YYYY-MM-DD. Partial dates are not allowed, and the value must be a real calendar date: Lexicon strings cannot carry a regex, so writers must validate the pattern and the calendar (reject 2023-02-29, month 00 or 13, day 00 or 32).

ended.description: Date the publisher ceased operating, exactly YYYY-MM-DD, with the same real-calendar validation as started.

createdAt.description: Time this publisher record was created, not a founding date.
